assessment_scope: Round-two independent formal Design Review of the exact registered Skill, Validation, CLI and Delivery Handoff package, against unchanged approved proposal and proposal-review. Reassessed the corrected CLI decision table, its current and historical callers, first-pass finding and correction evidence, and all package interactions. Prior complete-model/source inspection is retained only for the affirmatively unchanged subjects; the complete package judgment here is new. All four user goals and the full-inventory completion boundary remain included.
independence_basis: Separate nonauthor reviewer agent /root/all_skills_design_review performed the first-pass complete package assessment and independently assessed the author correction at commit 11157599995298c26bb851e2c130f90e58c091ee. Root authored every Design change before this review and stayed read-only during review. This reviewer authored only review/finding records and made no proposal, Design, implementation or plan edits.
limitations: Approval covers this exact four-model Design package for authorized planning only; it does not approve an execution plan, implementation or final readiness.

The full skill-package and test/script/fixture audit remains a required delivery completion obligation. Conditional retention does not establish that assessment complete, and additional behavior retirement requires its governing owner before removal.
No implementation tests, generated-candidate parity, universal agent compliance, external publication, installation or hosted validation result is claimed by this Design Review.
rationale: Direction and scope: SKL-SR-33 preserves all 19 packages, and VAL-SR-29 accounts for repository/package tests, fixtures, generated/direct-only cases and all script/support populations, including files outside the listed groups. Retention rows explicitly require current complete-package evidence during delivery; earlier approval, line count and reduced-suite passes cannot close unassessed work. This meets the proposal without pretending the broad implementation audit has already occurred.

Technical realization: the five selected entrypoints presently expose detailed adopted recording before their central task classification. Four existing local references can receive the complete procedures; Verify adds one local method. The Design preserves native invocation values and makes late-trigger loading, missing/escaped/mixed guidance stops and complete selected-path procedure explicit. It does not introduce a universal layout or a shared cross-skill runtime dependency. The proposed improvement has an observable before/after reading-path criterion rather than a relocation or length target.

Authority and portability: PR remains a read-only consumer of governed records, unlike author/reviewer/Verify producers. Route retains activity/work ownership, reviewers retain exact-package judgment and durable/formal triggers, and Verify retains scoped versus final classification, success-only rationale and conditional seven-field Git basis. Shared policy adoption, isolated work and customer feature-spec/source authority remain independently applicable. No review gate, schema, permission or external publication boundary changes.

Consumer adequacy: validate_targeted_recording_profile currently returns early when nonpilot inline Explicit recording is absent; review-placement and guidance tests also key off that heading. SKL-SR-34/35 and the named consumer reconciliation require positive mapped-path checks and negative missing/wrong/escaped/incomplete cases, preventing extraction from silently disabling validation. Existing canonical/archive/install observations retain their distinct boundaries. Exact implementation assertions and commands remain Delivery-owned.

Selected retirement: source inspection confirms query-change-record.py unconditionally prints unsupported-record-interface and returns 2 without reading a root. Its two RetiredQueryTests protect that path-specific rejection, and the skill fixture asserts its rejection text/no YAML loader. CLI-SR-31 deliberately withdraws that command and structured error promise; removal is not mislabeled equivalent proof. Validation names catalog ID/fingerprint, selectors, command fixtures and helper-path exception for coupled removal, while preserving current CLI/record safety and deleted-path routing. The metadata wrapper has actual delegated validation and error normalization and is correctly retained.

Test maintenance and risk: TEST-SR-07–10 and VAL-SR-29–31 require each removed/consolidated protection to have established retained detection or explicit owner retirement, including fixtures and real observation boundaries. Unknown protection blocks completion rather than being declared obsolete. The published-skill semantic-checklist guard remains until sufficient independently assessed replacement. Semantic inspection is not universal agent-compliance proof. These requirements are adequate Design inputs for a concrete reviewed allocation.

Artifact labels and responsibility: HAND-SR-04/HAND-DEC-02 remove the duplicate Explain-change artifact prompt while preserving the successful Verify rationale, core/conditional evidence groups, actual living Design or retained project architecture context, and all external-action prerequisites. The existing PR skeleton substantiates the stale label. Broadened Code Review description reflects its already-owned final whole-change duty without granting a new gate.

Architecture and examples: all four affected models have an overview, labeled authority/input/output relationships and explicit supporting-view decisions. Their existing necessary views still describe the selected changes: method relocation remains inside published Skill packaging and one retired repository helper does not add a CLI/validation subsystem. No declared example is modified. System composition, Assessment policy and runtime/packaging owners retain their current boundaries; no new detailed owner is needed.

Decision preservation: CLI-DEC-07 now documents the original single v3 stored-adapter, independent-transport and bounded archive-recognition decision without changing its historical references. Query-helper withdrawal is separately CLI-DEC-08, unused in the inspected pre-correction tree. This resolves the first-pass collision without changing CLI-SR-31 or its supported-interface safeguards. The original reporter explicitly resolved skills-dr-01 with correction evidence; the prior changes-requested judgment and exact subjects remain intact and its applicability is stale.

Whole-package current reliance: current CLI-inspected identities equal all four registered model references. Every first-pass relied-on subject except the corrected CLI model is byte-identical, including proposal/review, other three models, source procedures, validators, callers, tests and historical plan. Git diff confirms the sole engineering delta is the reviewed decision-table correction; accompanying workflow evidence adds no changed product authority. Prior complete readings and unchanged source inspection therefore remain adequate, with the corrected CLI meaning reassessed here. Scope/requirements/resource destinations, safety preservation, proof obligations and owner boundaries still form one coherent package.

Validation and claim boundary: independently ran python scripts/validate-boundary-first.py --check --path docs/design/cli/cli.md successfully after correction. The earlier independently observed four-model structural pass remains applicable to the other unchanged three models. Semantic review, rather than those structural checks, establishes the corrected decision meaning. Full implementation-package inspection, all test/script/fixture relevance dispositions and exact executable proof remain explicit Delivery obligations; no existing proposal feasibility or historical cleanup approval is broadened into completion evidence.
summary: The complete four-model refinement package is coherent and sufficiently specified for authorized delivery planning. The corrected decision mapping preserves prior v2-retirement authority and separately identifies query-helper withdrawal.
